title: Celestin's early big brass band versus the later smaller band
summary: When Thomas joined, Celestin led seven to ten pieces, unlike the earlier twenty-piece brass band that used the two-by-four.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Uh, you were mentioning about, uh, Papa Salastain, uh, knocking out with the, uh, two-by-four. Did he do that in later years when you joined the band?

No, no, no, he didn't. You just, uh, when I joined the band, he had a smaller band than, uh, uh, seven or eight pieces of the moors. Perhaps ten when we had to play at the hotels that called for ten pieces or some of these halls, you know, called for ten pieces. But, uh, the time I'm talking about, he, oh, he had a, oh, big, uh, brass band, I think it was, like, uh, about twenty pieces.
